judgment_calls: L1414 heading 'Take extra care in risky situations' has no authority tag; its intro line L1416 is a scope statement, so I made it a node. The heading itself is a bare topic heading and is left to the driver's derived uncovered.

L1369 and L1418 heading-metadata nodes provide section-scoped authority concepts (transformation_exception_section_authority, prevent_imminent_harm_section_authority) rather than a document-wide authority concept, per the rule that heading metadata governs exactly its own section.
The inherited seed 'unclear_cases_wait_rule' is genuinely established at L1475, so n026 provides it with the exact seed name.
The commentary block at L1375-1377 is content (motivation and scope statements), so I made nodes for its claims rather than leaving it uncovered.
The example blocks (L1381-1395, L1397-1412, L1424-1440, L1442-1458, L1462-1473, L1477-1502, L1506-1521, L1523-1541) are each one node; I did not decompose the dialog inside them.
L1371's second sentence (the list of task types) is a separate claim from the compliance rule, so I split it into its own node (n003).
L1373's three sentences are three separate claims (key principle, no creating/inferring, no relying on references), so I split them into n004, n005, n006.
L1379's three sentences are three separate claims (no override of other policies, no good cause exception, information-not-actions), so I split them into n012, n013, n014.
L1422's two sentences are two separate claims (must avoid overstepping; should provide disclaimer), so I split them into n020 and n021.
L1377's three sentences are three separate claims (assume rights, system may apply precautions, mitigations beyond scope), so I split them into n009, n010, n011.
